newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS $50 MLN THAI DCS NETWORK DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS $50 MLN THAI DCS NETWORK DEAL.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Friday it will deliver digital cellular network equipment for the expansion of Total Access Communications' (TAC) DCS 1800 network in Thailand.
"The agreement is valued at around $50 million, and the deliveries are starting immediately," Nokia said.

Under the agreement Nokia will deliver expansions to the mobile switching network, base stations and base station controllers as well as implementation and operating and maintenance services, it said.
"The contract further strengthens Nokia's position as the main supplier to TAC's DCS 1800 network," Nokia said.
TAC is part of the Thai UCOM group .
